title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16748v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to support physically grounded self-improvement in video generation models. The harness guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction, distilling their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos. The framework supports controllable training-data construction and inference-time video repair. translated_title: PhysLoop：利用大语言模型的物理感知能力实现视频生成模型的自我改进
translated_abstract: 视频生成模型能够生成视觉上逼真的视频，但在物理动态和因果一致性方面仍存在不足。从生成的视频中学习需要细粒度的物理监督，然而可靠的质量判断、修正配对以及可控的变化都难以获得。大语言模型（LLM）虽然拥有物理知识，但难以可靠地引导视频生成模型生成其训练所需的视频。我们提出了PhysLoop，一个旨在支持视频生成模型基于物理的自我改进的统一框架。该框架在视频生成、选择和修正的全过程中引导并约束大语言模型，将其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频。该框架支持可控的训练数据构建以及推理阶段的视频修复。通过识别和纠正失败，PhysLoop标志着视频生成模型向递归自我改进（RSI）迈出了关键里程碑。
tldr: PhysLoop提出了一个统一框架，通过在视频生成、选择和修正的全过程中引导并约束大语言模型，将其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频数据，从而实现视频生成模型基于物理的自我改进与递归自我提升。
en_tdlr: PhysLoop is a unified harness that guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction to distill their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos, enabling physically grounded self-improvement and recursive self-improvement in video generation models.
